Game Overview

Birdy Rush puts players into a animal experience centered on guide a plucky bird through a cascade of tumbling crates. Scale the stacks, collect grains, and unlock charming allies as you aim for the top score. With vibrant landscapes and endless action, Birdy Rush keeps you captivated, making every playthrough a delightful challenge to master.
